'''Vilnau Teupt''' was the keynote speaker at the four hundred twelfth [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]]. Teupt delivered their speech, "[[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul]]," at the [[Brentaal Academy]].<ref>''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
